sn45.139:1.2: yāvatā bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
sn45.139:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā,
sn45.139:1.5: appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn45.139:1.6: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.139:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.139:1.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti. ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
sn45.139:2.1: 1. 13. 2. dutiya tathāgatasuttaṃ yāvatā bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
sn45.139:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn45.139:2.3: appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati. ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn45.139:2.4: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.139:2.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.
sn45.139:2.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
sn45.139:3.1: 1. 13. 3. tatiya tathāgatasuttaṃ yāvatā bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
sn45.139:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn45.139:3.3: appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ “ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatī”ti.
sn45.139:3.4: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.139:3.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti amatogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti amatogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
sn45.139:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
sn45.139:4.1: 1. 13. 4. catuttha tathāgatasuttaṃ yāvatā bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
sn45.139:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā.
sn45.139:4.4: appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: “ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatī”ti.
sn45.139:4.5: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.139:4.6: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ.
sn45.139:4.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
